thread:
Maya: FYI incident bot just created PM-932 after last night's paging spike. Can we schedule a short postmortem and assign action owners?
Liam: Ack. I can take the initial triage notes. When's a good ~30m window?
oncall-bot: Created postmortem doc: https://pm.redwood.internal/pm-932 (owner: unassigned). Added tag: customer-impact, paging.
Priya: Please add a customer-impact section. We need to quantify affected requests and errors/min.
Maya: @Priya good call. @Liam can you pull the K8s request rates and error budgets?
Liam: Yep will grab charts and paste in the doc. ETA 2h.
Jorge: We should also capture mitigation timeline + who paged whom. That went messy. Suggest adding a 'handoff timeline' template field.
Nora: +1 to a small template update. Could the postmortem bot auto-populate a 'handoff timeline' section from the incident timeline events?
Maya: That's the idea I wanted to discuss — proposal: postmortem-bot should: 1) create doc, 2) fetch SRE timeline events, 3) pre-fill handoff timeline, 4) open action items in the actionboard.
Priya: If we automate action item creation, include fields: owner, due_date, priority, linked-pr, and a 'customer-impact' tag.
Liam: Maybe the bot can suggest owners based on oncall rotation history. At least pre-fill suggested owner.
oncall-bot: Action created: AB-1287 "Investigate KV cache thrash" (owner: unassigned) link: https://actionboard.redwood/internal/AB-1287
Jorge: For rollout: can we add a quick 'remediation confidence' checkbox that the bot populates after owners mark done? Helps prioritization.
Maya: Let's schedule 30m postmortem tomorrow 10:30am. @Liam prepare charts, @Priya add customer-impact section draft, @Jorge draft template changes. I'll file an RFC for the bot changes after we sync.
Nora: One more ask — actionboard should expose a 'postmortem sprint' view so PMs can track hotfixes separately.
Maya: Noted. I'll open a ticket. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
